content: सूक्ष्म {%a.%} [सूच्-मन् सुक् च नेट्; <ls>Uṇ. 4. 184</ls>] .²1 Subtle, minute, atomic; जालान्तरस्थसूर्यांशौ यत् सूक्ष्मं दृश्यते रजः; मुख्यक्रमेण प्रयोगवचनैकवाक्यता सूक्ष्मा <ls>ŚB. on MS. 5. 1. 15</ls>. .²2 Little, small; इदमुपहितसूक्ष्मग्रन्थिना स्कन्धदेशे <ls>Ś. 1. 19</ls>; <ls>R. 18. 49</ls>. .²3 Fine, thin, delicate, exquisite. .²4 Nice. .²5 Sharp, acute, penetrating. .²6 Crafty, artful, subtle, ingenious. .²7 Exact, precise, accurate, correct. .{@-क्ष्मः@} .²1 An atom. .²2 The clearing-nut plant. .²3 An epithet of Śiva. .{@-क्ष्मा@} .²1 Sand. .²2 Small cardamoms. .{@-क्ष्मम्@} .²1 The subtle all-pervading spirit, the Supreme Soul. .²2 Minuteness. .²3 One of the three kinds of power attainable by an ascetic; <ab>cf.</ab> सावद्य. .²4 Craft, ingenuity. .²5 Fraud, cheating. .²6 Fine thread <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a figure of speech, thus defined by Mammaṭa:-- कुतोऽपि लक्षितः सूक्ष्मोप्यर्थोऽन्यस्मै प्रकाश्यते . धर्मेण केनचिद्यत्र तत्सूक्ष्मं परिचक्षते .. <ls>K.
